title: G45 Save State Manifest
methodology: Filesystem inventory of all game-related save/config files on the system

SaveData.json.content: MasterDataVersion (int 109) + MasterDataFile[] array listing ~80 master data CSV filenames
SaveData.json.conclusion: Master data manifest only. NOT a player save file.

Game\\Game.json.content: Test mode game settings (GameEnableTournament=0, GameSeatSetting=1, etc.)

Setting\\test_mode_setting.json.content: Full test mode config (nesica_time_setting, network_setting, one_play_free=OFF, free_play=OFF)

SlotNumber.sav.content: Binary UE4 GVAS save containing BP_DevelopMenuSlotNumber_C

table_player_progress.conclusion: Tutorial state is NOT stored server-side

conclusion: ONBOARDING_NOT_PERSISTED - No player-specific save file, no tutorial/progress file, no database record. Onboarding state is determined at runtime by the game's state machine based on server responses and NESYS card events.
